title: Complete-intersection fibre neighbourhood after principal localization
statement: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure, $q\in\operatorname{Spec}S$ a prime, and $g\in S\setminus q$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Put $p=q\cap R$ and $Q=\ker(\kappa(p)\otimes_R S\to\kappa(q))$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Assume some $h\in(\kappa(p)\otimes_R S)\setminus Q$ has $(\kappa(p)\otimes_R S)_h$ a global complete intersection over $\kappa(p)$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. Then there is a prime $q_1$ of $S_g$ contracting to $q$ such that, for $p_1=q_1\cap R$ and $Q_1=\ker(\kappa(p_1)\otimes_R S_g\to\kappa(q_1))$, some $h_1\notin Q_1$ has $(\kappa(p_1)\otimes_R S_g)_{h_1}$ a global complete intersection over $\kappa(p_1)$.

source.place: 00SY (3) => (2), first sentence, and 00SA for the fibre condition

proof.text: Extend $q$ to $q_1=qS_g$, which contracts to $q$ since $g\notin q$. The prime-local rings and residue fields are canonically isomorphic [lem-weil-pbc-localization-prime-residue-field-iso]; the base prime is unchanged. Tensoring with its residue field identifies the new fibre with the localization of the old fibre $F$ at $\bar g=1\otimes g$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-tensor-over-base]. The canonical prime contracts to $Q$ by compatibility of the maps to the residue fields. Thus the image of $h$ stays outside the prime. The localization at this image is $(F_{\bar g})_{h/1}\cong(F_h)_{\bar g/1}$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-of-localization]. The latter is a global complete intersection by [lem-weil-pbc-global-complete-intersection-principal-localization]. Transport the presentation and dimension along the canonical residue-field and fibre algebra isomorphisms to conclude.

theorem exists_completeIntersection_fibre_away
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S)
    (g : S) (hg : g ∉ q.asIdeal)
    (hci : ∃ h : (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).Fiber S,
      h ∉ (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (q.comap (algebraMap R S))
        ⟨q, rfl⟩).asIdeal ∧
      IsGlobalCompleteIntersection (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).ResidueField
        (Localization.Away h)) :
    ∃ q₁ : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away g),
      q₁.comap (algebraMap S (Localization.Away g)) = q ∧
      ∃ h : (q₁.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))).Fiber
          (Localization.Away g),
        h ∉ (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R (Localization.Away g)
          (q₁.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))) ⟨q₁, rfl⟩).asIdeal ∧
        IsGlobalCompleteIntersection
          (q₁.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))).ResidueField
          (Localization.Away h)
